root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `read_begin()` enters `pobegin()` and the notes-backed pseudo-op-table allocation path, the global `notes` obstack must already be initialized so `notes.chunkfun.plain != NULL`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable startup reaches `read_begin()` with the global `notes` obstack still zero-initialized because the harness omitted `obstack_begin(&notes, chunksize)`. The fixed startup reaches the same `read_begin()` entry with a live chunk allocator stored in `notes.chunkfun.plain`, so the later obstack allocation path no longer dispatches through NULL.

nodes.state: At the sink, `call_chunkfun()` is on the plain-allocator branch and the `h->chunkfun.plain` function pointer it is about to call is still NULL.
`notes_alloc()` consumes the same global `notes` obstack state seen at `read_begin()` entry and passes that uninitialized obstack into `obstack_alloc(&notes, size)`.

edges.relation: The same `notes.chunkfun.plain` field value present when `read_begin()` starts is still present when `notes_alloc()` later consumes the `notes` obstack, so the missing initialization survives into the allocation path unchanged.
`notes_alloc()` passes the global `notes` obstack into `obstack_alloc(&notes, size)`, and `call_chunkfun()` later receives that same obstack as its `h` argument on the crashing path.
